recognize_zh: 中倍 H&E 下成熟脂肪細胞與大片細胞密集的造血組織交錯，造血區內可見紅血球前驅細胞、骨髓系細胞與少數深染的大型細胞（疑為巨核細胞），並有較密集的小淋巴球聚集，整體如同脂肪內的骨髓，符合腎上腺骨髓脂肪瘤。
features: Admixture of mature adipocytes and cellular hematopoietic tissue in roughly equal proportions
Hematopoietic areas composed of small dark erythroid precursors and granulocytic cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm
Occasional larger hyperchromatic cells consistent with megakaryocytes
Denser cluster of small round cells in the center, possibly a lymphoid aggregate or erythroid cluster
Congested red cells and delicate fibrous septa; no lipoblasts or atypical stromal cells
describe_en: Section of the adrenal mass at medium power shows mature adipocytes intermixed with cellular hematopoietic tissue containing erythroid and granulocytic precursors, occasional megakaryocyte-like cells, congested red cells and a denser central aggregate of small round cells. Delicate fibrous septa are present, and there are no lipoblasts or cytologically atypical stromal cells. Lineage detail is limited at this magnification. Findings are consistent with adrenal myelolipoma with a prominent hematopoietic component.

ddx.vs: Forms masses of hematopoietic tissue in patients with marrow failure or hemoglobinopathy, typically without a substantial mature adipose component.
Features atypical hyperchromatic stromal cells and lipoblasts in fibrous septa, rather than trilineage hematopoiesis.

ddx.dx: Involvement by lymphoma or myeloid sarcoma
ddx.vs: Shows a monotonous sheet of atypical lymphoid cells or blasts effacing the tissue, rather than orderly maturing multilineage hematopoiesis.
